summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for AuraShield AI, an advanced real-time fraud detection and credential verification platform for jobs, internships, freelance offers, fake certificates, and HR candidate claim audits. Includes universal real-time input methods (text paste, live URL fetcher, multimodal document upload, and chat forward parser), a prominent hero risk gauge with direct 4-tier risk classification (Critical, High, Low, No Risk), and full HR enforcement tools.
